style: --field-border: var(--border-color, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)); --field-accent: var(--accent, #38bdf8); --field-text: var(--navy-900, #0f172a); position: relative; width: 100%; text-align: left; display: block; flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 0 0 0 10px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--field-border); outline: none; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); height: 40px; box-sizing: border-box; &:hover { border-color: var(--field-accent); } &:has(input:focus), &:has(input:not(:placeholder-shown)) { border-color: var(--field-accent); } &:has(input:focus) > legend, &:has(input:not(:placeholder-shown)) > legend { visibility: visible; max-width: 100%; } &:has(input:focus) > label, &:has(input:not(:placeholder-shown)) > label { top: 0; padding: 0 10px; left: 5px; color: var(--field-accent); transform: translateY(-50%); font-size: 11px; }
